policy.basis: Copyright and Related Rights Act NN 111/21, Article 18(3): officially published legal, administrative, and judicial texts (including statutes, regulations, and court decisions) cease to be protected by copyright when published for official public information.
policy.scope: Individually identified official legislative texts published in the Narodne novine official part, including the four NN 86/21 Form 4b and Form 11b images independently reviewed as integral legal annexes on 2026-10-25; the four unchanged MUP EEA forms and three unchanged MUP SIS forms; the identified MUP EEA guidance article body with attribution under MUP Terms of Use; the individual blank MVEP VIS administrative form under a narrow Article 18(3) assessment; the static AZOP complaint-route article body and the selected SIS data-subject-rights subsection with attribution under AZOP Terms of Use; and the individually identified MVEP family-member, visa-application, visa-overview and Croatian appeal articles and Ombudsman complaint article under source-specific inferences that the named pages meet the official-publication conditions in Copyright Act NN 111/21 Article 18(3), with Article 15(3) applied only where a named official translation is published for public information. These page assessments are limited to the named official article text and attribution; they do not create a site-wide licence. Excludes publisher shells, third-party page content, other unreviewed website content, live or downloadable forms not separately accepted, and bulk/database-wide reuse. The MVEP legacy FAQ body and the Information Commissioner English “Right to access information” section are additionally retained as historical-only official public-information excerpts under separate source-specific Article 18(3) and, for the official English versions, Article 15(3) inferences; neither may be used as current guidance.
policy.retention_rule: Retain official Narodne novine text fragments and the four individually reviewed NN 86/21 card-specimen JPEG annexes with their accepted parent act; the seven unchanged MUP form PDFs with MUP attribution; the identified MUP EEA guidance article body; the one MVEP VIS form under the narrow Article 18(3) assessment; and the nine named authority article bodies or subsections accepted on 2026-10-25 (the seven existing AZOP, MVEP and Ombudsman records, plus the historical MVEP FAQ and Commissioner section). Keep publisher, official URL, language, review date, version/cutoff, source-response evidence where archived, local hash and reuse basis. For pages without a saved raw response, retain the candidate note’s historical hashes and record that limitation. Exclude site navigation/shell, other pages, third-party content, live forms, optional DOCX/PDFs, user submissions and unrelated linked materials. Preserve original wording and identify any omitted dynamic or unverified links. For the two historical-only excerpts, retain the prominent warning, exact archived response hash, page date/currentness evidence and the source boundaries; do not use them as current process instructions.
not_covered: full publisher HTML responses and page-shell text
website design, navigation and interface text; only the individually identified MUP, AZOP, MVEP and Ombudsman article bodies and forms named in scope are retained
third-party materials, non-text attachments, images and logos unless independently reviewed as individual official source documents
bulk extraction or reuse of any publisher database as a whole, including separate database rights or technical conditions

general MVEP website content: the page labelled “Terms of use” inspected is a personal-data notice and is not a general reuse grant; each retained MVEP page is assessed individually under the identified statutory text basis
other Ombudsman pages and linked complaint forms not separately reviewed and accepted
the AZOP optional downloadable complaint-form DOCX and live data-bearing online form; neither is retained or relied upon here
the AZOP SIS/VIS article beyond the accepted SIS data-subject-rights subsection; its other SIS II descriptions and VIS section are not retained or covered by this source-specific permission review
The contents of the separate MVEP visa-fee link in the legacy FAQ; other Commissioner page sections and linked publications; neither is retained or assessed here.

retrieval_constraints.individual_official_record_urls: use the stable Narodne novine/ELI record URL, not the metadata API as a full-text endpoint
retrieval_constraints.automated_request_rate: maximum three queries per second per the live Narodne novine data-access page
retrieval_constraints.full_page_response_retention: not in the repository; ignored local response may be used transiently to create the official-text fragment
